parsedVerdict.reasoning: The src/application module is a cohesive application-service layer for order fulfilment: six use-case classes plus two shared helpers (order-dto.ts mapping/DTO contracts, require-order.ts lookup guard). The module's own abstractions are used consistently: every single-order lookup goes through requireOrder (Advance, Cancel, Get), and every order result goes through toOrderDto (Advance, Cancel, Get, ListOrdersByState, PlaceOrder). Business rules are not duplicated: reservation/release live in domain reserveStock/releaseStock, state transitions in Order.advanceTo/cancel, state validation in isOrderState. Minor observations that do not rise to a violation: PlaceOrderUseCase and CancelOrderUseCase repeat the orchestration pattern of findByIds -> Map by id -> save each product (glue code, not an invariant); ListStockLevelsUseCase maps StockLevelDto inline rather than through a named mapper (only one site, so no duplication); StockLevelDto is housed in order-dto.ts, a naming issue rather than a split of concerns.
